arxiv-2106-10658.title: Exploring Semantic Relationships for Unpaired Image Captioning
arxiv-2106-10658.creator: Fenglin Liu, Meng Gao, Tianhao Zhang, Yuexian Zou
arxiv-2106-10658.description: Abstract Recently, image captioning has aroused great interest in both academic and industrial worlds. Most existing systems are built upon large-scale datasets consisting of image-sentence pairs, which, however, are time-consuming to construct. In addition, even for the most advanced image captioning systems, it is still difficult to realize deep image understanding.

arxiv-2108-11219.title: A Nanographene Disk Rotating a single Molecule Gear on a Cu(111) Surface
arxiv-2108-11219.creator: H.-H. Lin, A. Croy, R. Gutierrez, C. Joachim, G. Cuniberti
arxiv-2108-11219.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by H.-H. Lin, A. Croy, R. Gutierrez, C. Joachim, G. Cuniberti. We perform molecular dynamics simulations to study the collective rotation of a graphene nanodisk functionalized on its circumference by tert -butylphenyl chemical groups in interaction with a molecule-gear hexa- tert -butylphenylbenzene supported by a Cu(111) surface. The rotational motion can be categorized under-driving, driving and overdriving regimes calculating the locking coefficient of this machinery as a function of external torque applied.

arxiv-2206-05758.title: Links in projective planar graphs
arxiv-2206-05758.creator: Joel Foisy, Luis Ángel Topete Galván, Evan Knowles, Uriel Alejandro Nolasco, Yuanyuan Shen, Lucy Wickham
arxiv-2206-05758.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Joel Foisy, Luis Ángel Topete Galván, Evan Knowles, Uriel Alejandro Nolasco, Yuanyuan Shen, Lucy Wickham. A graph G G is nonseparating projective planar if G G has a projective planar embedding without a nonsplit link. Nonseparating projective planar graphs are closed under taking minors and are a superclass of projective outerplanar graphs.

arxiv-2209-10773.title: Asymptotic stability of rarefaction waves for compressible Navier-Stokes equations with relaxation
arxiv-2209-10773.creator: Yuxi Hu and Xuefang Wang
arxiv-2209-10773.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yuxi Hu and Xuefang Wang. The asymptotic stability of rarefaction wave for 1-d relaxed compressible isentropic Navier-Stokes equations is established. For initial data with different far-field values, we show that there exists a unique global in time solution. Moreover, as time goes to infinity, the obtained solutions are shown to converge uniformly to rarefaction wave solution of p p -system with corresponding Riemann initial data. The proof is based on L 2 L^{2} energy methods.

arxiv-2306-12034.title: Bismuth Phase Dependent Growth of Superconducting NiBi 3 Nanorods
arxiv-2306-12034.creator: Laxmipriya Nanda, Bidyadhar Das, Subhashree Sahoo, Pratap K. Sahoo, Kartik Senapati
arxiv-2306-12034.description: Abstract We report a study on the growth of NiBi 3 nanowires and nanorods during the preparation of superconducting NiBi 3 films by co-evaporation of Ni and Bi. We find that NiBi 3 films grown via co-evaporation of Ni and Bi metals achieve higher transition temperatures (4.4 K) compared even to the single crystal NiBi 3 .

arxiv-2501-09817.title: Generalized Single-Image-Based Morphing Attack Detection Using Deep Representations from Vision Transformer
arxiv-2501-09817.creator: Haoyu Zhang, Raghavendra Ramachandra, Kiran Raja, Christoph Busch
arxiv-2501-09817.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Haoyu Zhang, Raghavendra Ramachandra, Kiran Raja, Christoph Busch. Face morphing attacks have posed severe threats to Face Recognition Systems (FRS), which are operated in border control and passport issuance use cases. Correspondingly, morphing attack detection algorithms (MAD) are needed to defend against such attacks. MAD approaches must be robust enough to handle unknown attacks in an open-set scenario where attacks can originate from various morphing generation algorithms, post-processing and the diversity of printers/scanners.

pmc-11612450.creator: Wandi Xiong, Kaiyu Xu, Jacquelyne Ka-Li Sun, Siling Liu, Baizhen Zhao, Jie Shi, Karl Herrup, Hei-Man Chow, Lin Lu, Jiali Li
pmc-11612450.description: Maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis is crucial for cell survival and organismal health, as evidenced by the links between mitochondrial dysfunction and various diseases, including Alzheimer’s disease (AD). pmc-13319421.description: INTRODUCTIONSimilarities between frontotemporal lobar degeneration with transactive response DNA‐binding protein of 43 kDa (TDP‐43) (FTLD‐TDP) and limbic‐predominant age‐related TDP‐43 encephalopathy neuropathologic change (LATE‐NC) raise questions about whether they represent distinct entities or a single disease spectrum. pmc-13491367.title: A Longitudinal Investigation of the Emotional Experience of Men Using Medically Assisted Reproduction
pmc-13491367.creator: Ariel Trépanier Freire, Audrey Brassard, Natalie O. Rosen, Laurie R. Beauvilliers, Sophie Bergeron, Katherine Péloquin
pmc-13491367.description: The diagnosis of infertility and medically assisted reproduction (MAR) can have significant emotional consequences for couples. Little is known about male partners’ emotional experience during MAR with their partner. This longitudinal study examined the emotional experience of 154 North American men (mean age = 34.12, SD = 5.22) toward their partner over 12 to 18 months of MAR treatment.

pmc-13597641.title: Early Postoperative Rehabilitation Behavior After Total Joint Arthroplasty: A Theory-Informed Qualitative Study
pmc-13597641.creator: Zhonghua Xu, Zhenzhen Du, Ran Chen, Liangliang Wang, Jinhong Gong, Dan Su, Xindie Zhou, Jingjing Shang
pmc-13597641.description: BackgroundEarly postoperative rehabilitation is important for recovery after total joint arthroplasty (TJA), but patients’ engagement may be influenced by multiple psychological, cognitive, and social factors. This study explored the facilitators and barriers to early postoperative rehabilitation behavior using the Health Belief Model (HBM) and Social Cognitive Theory (SCT) as interpretive frameworks.

pmc-13609993.description: Gel electrophoresis is widely used for protein and nucleic acid analysis. Nucleic acid recovery from agarose gels is convenient and efficient, but protein recovery is not. This study aimed to develop and validate a novel method for recovering proteins from gels.

pmc-13626626.title: Stress cardiomyopathy following antibiotic-induced anaphylaxis in a 16-month-old child
pmc-13626626.creator: Mareddy Nikhila Reddy, Ramya Keerthy, Rajesh Babu Gudipati, Ravinder Reddy Lotkal
pmc-13626626.description: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy (TTC) is a reversible stress-induced myocardial syndrome characterized by transient left ventricular (LV) dysfunction in the absence of coronary artery disease. Pediatric cases are rare, especially in infants and toddlers. We report a 16-month-old female child who developed TTC following severe pneumonia complicated by antibiotic-induced anaphylaxis, cardiopulmonary arrest, and catecholamine exposure during resuscitation.
